杨云帆看着前方那在建筑群里高高耸起的大厦，一直顺着这个方向走，都走了半个小时了，不过眼下看来，估计还得走半小时。
不过，早晨阳光明媚，微风轻抚，这湘潭市因为绿化做的不错，空气新鲜，吸进鼻子里，有一股生命的香味。
伴随着暖暖的阳光和淡淡的轻风，杨云帆走在公路上，心情也不由得的放松了起来。
“也不知道我那个未婚妻长得什么样子？一般有本事的女人，多半长得不怎么好看。要是她长得太丑，就算老头子杀了我，我也要退婚。我可不能对着一个丑八怪一辈子。”杨云帆心里想到。
只是，杨云帆走了一会儿，忽然发现，前面车堵得有点厉害。
好多人围在一起，不知道在看什么。
“嗯？这里是怎么回事？”
只见公路上，横着一辆大货车，大货车的旁边有一辆红色的跑车，此时那辆跑车整个翻到在一旁，前面的挡风玻璃也碎了一地。
远远的，杨云帆就看到地上鲜红色的一滩血迹，非常显眼！
“不好，出车祸了！”
杨云帆根本没有细想，就飞快的朝着那车祸地点跑过去。
虽然杨云帆从来不认为自己是个好人，但是自己一身本事，当然不能浪费。
“让开一点，闲杂人等，不要过来！”
“说你呢？让开一点，围着干什么。退开，退开！”
因为距离车祸地点不远就有一个警察站点，所以警察在车祸发生的第一时间，就已经赶到了现场，此刻正忙着维护现场的秩序，并且和赶来的消防员一起，将伤者从车内救出来。
只是，交警和消防队员毕竟不是专业医生，虽然懂一些急救措施，但是却怎么也无法跟真正的医生相比。
伤者是一男一女，那男的浑身刺青，留着个板寸，凶神恶煞的，怎么看也不是好人。可这会儿，他正全身发抖，既不敢碰那昏迷不醒的女子，也不敢离开，只是在那嚎啕大哭。
“林姐，你可不能有事啊！你要出了事，我许强可怎么办？”
大货车因为是左转弯，撞击的是接触点正好是车子的右面，那个位置，是副驾驶室的所在。跑车内的女子正好坐在那里，所以受到重创。而那个开车的男子，因为远离第一撞击点，所以只是擦破了一点皮，伤势并不严重。

“这车门都撞的没样了，看来这女的伤的不轻啊。”
“救护车现在都没有来，来了也晚了。”
路旁人纷纷议论道。
现场的情况看去，跑车倒在路边，整个车门此时都已经完全变形，车门上的玻璃也都碎成了渣滓。
而在车前的挡风玻璃上，还残留着一滩血迹，应该是那女子头部的伤口出血所致。
那女子被抢救出来时，头部伤口非常严重，血流如注，很快，她就昏迷过去了。
另外，她的头部外伤虽然看起来非常恐怖，但是如今已经包扎止血。
可是她却仍旧昏迷不醒，而且情况似乎越来越糟糕。
有经验的消防员已经预感到，很有可能，刚刚那一次巨大的撞击，导致了她颅内出血，所以她才会昏迷不醒。
不远处，一名女警察正在的给急救中心打电话，她的额头上全是汗水。她是事故发生后，第一个来到的现场的交警。
这名女警打完电话，赶忙朝一个中年交警跑过来，边跑边焦急道：“队长，急救中心说他们已经派人来了，但是，还需要最少十分钟时间才能到。我看那个女的快坚持不住了。现在我们该怎么办？”
那个队长也没有办法，只好对那女交警道：“我们尽力而为吧。你去看着那名女伤者，有任何情况，立即向我报告！”
“是！”
那名女警赶紧回到了那名女伤者身边。
或许是因为从来没有见过类似的惨烈车祸，所以这女警此刻非常紧张，原本俏丽的脸庞也显得有些苍白。此时她最大的愿望，就是能够尽快见到一名医生。虽然，她从小就不喜欢去医院。
“请让一让，让我过去。”
这个时候，一个不起眼的身影正快速穿过人群。不知道为何，所有人都不自觉的为他让开一条路。
而当他刚刚挤开人群，走到警戒线前，就被负责维持秩序的年轻警察给拦了下来。
“你干什么？退回去！”
年轻警察的神情非常严肃，狠狠瞪着杨云帆。他以为杨云帆是过来看热闹的人。

Yang Yunfan looked at the towering buildings in front of him. He had been walking in this direction for half an hour, but now it seemed that he would still have to walk for half an hour.
However, the sun was shining brightly in the morning and the breeze was caressing. Xiangtan City has done a good job in greening. The air is fresh and there is a fragrance of life when you breathe it into your nose.
Accompanied by the warm sunshine and light breeze, Yang Yunfan couldn't help but feel relaxed as he walked on the road.
"I wonder what my fiancée looks like? Most capable women are not very good-looking. If she is too ugly, even if the old man kills me, I will break off the engagement. I can't face an ugly guy for the rest of my life." Yang Yunfan thought to himself.
However, Yang Yunfan walked for a while and suddenly found that there was a serious traffic jam in front of him.
Many people gathered around, not knowing what they were looking at.
"Huh? What's going on here?"
I saw a large truck lying sideways on the road. Next to the large truck was a red sports car. At this time, the sports car completely flipped to the side, and the windshield in front was shattered to the ground.
From a distance, Yang Yunfan saw a pool of bright red blood on the ground, which was very conspicuous!
"No, there was a car accident!"
Yang Yunfan didn't think about it at all and ran quickly towards the site of the car accident.
Although Yang Yunfan never thought that he was a good person, of course he could not waste his talents.
"Get out of the way, there are other people waiting, don't come over!"
"What about you? Get out of the way, what are you doing around here? Get out of the way, get out of the way!"
Because there was a police station not far from the site of the car accident, the police arrived at the scene as soon as the car accident occurred. They were busy maintaining order at the scene and working with the firefighters to rescue the injured from the car.
However, traffic policemen and firefighters are not professional doctors after all. Although they know some first aid measures, they cannot be compared with real doctors.
The injured were a man and a woman. The man was covered in tattoos and had a straight face. He looked fierce and looked like he was not a good person. But at this moment, he was trembling all over. He neither dared to touch the unconscious woman nor left, but just cried there.
"Sister Lin, nothing can happen to you! If something happens to you, what will I, Xu Qiang, do?"
Because the large truck was turning left, the point of impact was exactly on the right side of the vehicle, where the passenger compartment is located. The woman in the sports car happened to be sitting there, so she was hit hard. As for the man driving the car, because he was far away from the first impact point, his skin was only scratched and his injuries were not serious.
"The car door was broken. It seems that the woman was seriously injured."
"The ambulance hasn't come yet, and it's too late when it comes."
People on the roadside talked about it.
Judging from the situation at the scene, the sports car fell on the side of the road, the entire door was completely deformed, and the glass on the door was shattered into debris.
There was still a pool of blood on the windshield in front of the car, which should have been caused by the bleeding from the wound on the woman's head.
When the woman was rescued, her head wound was very serious and she was bleeding profusely. She soon passed out.
In addition, although her head injury looked very horrific, it has now been bandaged to stop the bleeding.
But she was still unconscious, and her condition seemed to be getting worse.
Experienced firefighters had a premonition that it was very likely that the huge impact just now caused intracranial hemorrhage, which was why she was unconscious.
Not far away, a female police officer was calling the emergency center, her forehead was covered with sweat. She was the first traffic policeman to arrive at the scene after the accident.
thisAfter the policewoman made the call, she hurriedly ran towards a middle-aged traffic policeman and said anxiously: "Captain, the emergency center said they have sent someone, but it will take at least ten minutes to arrive. I think that woman can't hold on any longer. What should we do now?"
The captain had no choice but to say to the female traffic policeman: "Let's do our best. Go and look at the injured woman. If there is any situation, report it to me immediately!"
"Yes!"
The policewoman quickly returned to the injured woman.
Perhaps because she had never seen a similar tragic car accident, the policewoman was very nervous at the moment, and her originally pretty face looked a little pale. Her biggest wish at this time is to see a doctor as soon as possible. Although, she has never liked going to the hospital since she was a child.
"Please give way and let me pass."
At this time, an inconspicuous figure was quickly passing through the crowd. For some reason, everyone unconsciously made way for him.
And when he just squeezed through the crowd and reached the police line, he was stopped by the young policeman responsible for maintaining order.
"What are you doing? Get back!"
The young policeman looked very serious and stared at Yang Yunfan fiercely. He thought Yang Yunfan was here to watch the fun.
